summary: Meta released Muse Spark 1.3, a point release in its Spark model line described as its strongest model for agentic and coding tasks.

practices.reason: The post claims gains on agentic tasks, coding, long-horizon work and instruction following but gives no benchmark figures to size the gain.
practices.quote: It’s designed to support longer-horizon work, excel in agentic tasks, and follow complex instructions more reliably than previous models.
